formatVersion.description: Session persistence format. The app migrates older versions at startup and on import, see packages/dashql-app/src/migration.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier (UUID v4). This is the authoritative identity; the storage location prefix is display-only.

sessionPath.description: Display-only path (e.g., "opfs://sessions/<uuid>" or "fs://<dir>"). Not authoritative and may be absent on newly written sessions.

storageType.description: Where this session's files live. Defaults to "opfs" when omitted.

nativePath.description: Absolute directory holding this session's files when storageType is "native".

name.description: User-supplied session name shown as the primary label in the session bar and selector. Absent (or empty) means the user never named the session, and the UI falls back to the display path.

defaultConnectionId.description: The connectionId of the connection that new scripts use and whose catalog the catalog files of the session copy.

connections.description: The connections that the scripts of the session use, the default connection included. The application's internal compute database is never persisted here.

scripts.description: The scripts of the session in feed order. Each entry names a file in scripts/ and the connection the script runs on. Files that are not listed are appended in natural order on load, entries without a file are dropped.

attachments.description: The files in attachments/ in natural order. Lets a session served over HTTP be fetched without a directory listing.

settings.description: The session settings. Absent in sessions written before settings existed.

SessionConnection.description: A connection referenced by the session

connectionId.description: The identifier (UUID) of the referenced connection in the connections of the app manifest

params.description: A copy of the saved connection parameters. The app manifest is the source of truth, the copy keeps the session folder self-contained.

paramsDraft.description: Legacy unsaved edits, only read when migrating to global connections. Drafts are kept in the app manifest.

name.description: The file name in scripts/, e.g. "01_extract.sql"

connectionId.description: The connectionId of the connection of the session that the script is analyzed and executed with

SessionOriginType.description: The origin type of the session

cacheQueryResults.description: Whether query results are cached and reused for unchanged queries
